mainEntity.name: How much does a multi-room interior renovation usually cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most homeowners compare the full project budget against their must-haves, then reserve money for labor, materials, design, permits, and a contingency. Whole-home and multi-room remodels in Denver can vary widely depending on scope and finishes, so a detailed written estimate is the safest way to understand the real price.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost depends on the number of rooms, finishes, and whether any structural or layout changes are involved. Ask for a detailed estimate with labor, materials, design, and permit costs separated.
